stories.title: More lifeguards, patrols and child-safety measures planned for KZN beaches
stories.summary: eThekwini and Umdoni are enhancing safety at their beaches. This includes more lifeguards, patrols, and child-safety measures for the festive season.
stories.angle: This is good news as it improves safety for beach visitors.
